purpose: Localize the Task14 L11H3 current-value effect within upstream MLP4--10 using both standalone donor writes and each layer's conditional contribution when all other MLP4--10 donor writes are present.

parent.finding: MLP0--3 recovered only 4--6%, MLP4--7 recovered 22--27%, and MLP8--10 recovered 66--71% of the all-MLP effect across the four task cells. No single coarse group met the frozen 70% margin-and-CE bar in every cell; number specificity held and interaction-needed was null. The combined MLP4--10 family is therefore the preregistered localization target.

novelty_audit.relation: The dossier explicitly says individual upstream MLP layers remain unidentified and requests a causal split of the accumulated family.
This measures downstream MLP13--17 compensation after H11.3, not MLP4--10 writes entering L11H3.
This is a downstream MLP15/17 interaction and does not test upstream current-value writers.
This uses named upstream sources for a copy-task MLP10 reader. It is bookkeeping precedent, not a Task14 per-layer intervention.
No registered failure or null duplicates the singleton-plus-leave-one Task14 MLP4--10 design.

exact_computation.propagated_slots: At each block entry, multiply every earlier MLP slot by that block's residual lambda0; at MLP i, add its native write to slot i. Thus slot i at pre-attention-11 equals the exact native write propagated through blocks i+1--11.
exact_computation.fixed_low_layers: Recipient MLP0--3 and the parent's M-grouping remainder remain fixed in every arm.
exact_computation.high_layer_remainder: Let H be the parent's exact G1+G2 MLP4--10 term. Sum propagated M4--10 slots in layer order and define rho_H=H-sum_i M_i. rho_H belongs to M4 and follows the M4 donor. Add it last within H.
exact_computation.fixed_context: Recipient E, A, parent state remainder R, attention probability p_8, cached value, and every non-subject L11H3 term remain fixed.
exact_computation.endpoint: Recompute RMSNorm and current V11H3 from the recombined pre-L11 subject state, combine current and cached values before one native output projection, install the resulting subject head term, and run the native suffix.
exact_computation.conditional_effect: For layer i, standalone is F({i})-F(empty); conditional is F(full)-F(full without i), computed separately for answer margin and full-vocabulary target CE improvement.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_live: All exactness gates pass and full donor MLP4--10 improves both task metrics in every cell.
predictions.pred_b_at_least_one_standalone_layer: One frozen layer handle alone recovers at least 25% of both full-family margin and CE, with at least 75% helpful rows, in every cell.
predictions.pred_c_at_least_one_conditional_layer: For one layer, full minus leave-one recovers at least 25% of both full-family metrics with at least 75% helpful row-level conditional effects in every cell.
predictions.pred_d_same_layer_is_stable: At least one layer passes both the standalone and conditional criteria across every cell.
predictions.pred_e_context_dependence: At least one layer's standalone and conditional recovery differ by at least 25% of the full-family effect for margin or CE in every cell.
predictions.pred_f_number_specific: All same-number lexical layer/full effects remain at most 25% of the full opposite-number MLP4--10 effect for both metrics.
predictions.pred_g_lexical_collateral: At least one same-number lexical effect reaches 50% of the number effect.

interpretation_limit: MLP layer boundaries are localization handles only. A passing layer identifies where a useful write enters this path; it does not establish that the whole native MLP is one semantic circuit or that different passing layers should remain separate.
